entry.title: Shade Coronets
experienceTags: Pairings: Coffee, cream ale, breakfast tea
Occasion: Morning smoke, quick daytime break, mild coffee pairing
entry.summaryHtml: Sweet cream, toasted bread, almond, cedar and light white pepper are the reported centre of Undercrown Shade, the pale counterpart to the Maduro and Sun Grown blends. An Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper sits over a Sumatra binder and a Dominican Criollo 98, Nicaraguan Criollo and Corojo filler, which keeps the blend medium-bodied rather than mild and gives the Coronet more structure than a typical shade-wrapped cigarillo. At 4″ × 32 it is the mildest Coronet in this cohort and the one most suited to a morning or coffee-hour smoke.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar Hut lists the exact 4″ × 32 tin of 10 at A$100, The Index and Cigarworld also stock the line, and the retailer matrix carries all three. Strength and Quality follow the Blackened S84 Coronet, the closest Shade-wrapped Drew Estate reference in the catalogue.
productionLines: Filler: Dominican Criollo 98, Nicaraguan Criollo and Corojo

note: Add Undercrown Shade Coronets to Coronets & Cigarillos at rank 14, directly above Blackened S84 Shade to Black Coronets, which moves to 15. Strength 6, Quality 7, Flavour 7 and Size gold are copied from S84 as requested, so both carry the same four Golds and the same Crown; Value stays automatically derived from price.
